resources.string: Allowed actions
Everything is allowed by default. Mark an action unverified or forbid it here.
Allowed: runs normally. Unverified: runs, is marked here, every use goes to the journal, and its confirmation says it is unverified. Forbidden: refused before anything reaches the vehicle.

Safety checks stay on whatever you choose: Park and zero speed for commands that are unsafe while moving, the confirmations before a reboot or a cluster write, the deployment integrity checks and the firmware identity of the root channel.
